input.quote: (b) Licensee agrees to allow an independent Certified Public Accountant or other Audit Professional, (selected by mutual agreement) to audit and analyze appropriate accounting records to ensure compliance with all terms of this Agreement. Any such audit shall be permitted by Licensee within 30 days of Licensee's receipt of a written request of Licensor.
input.rationale: The audit right binding us (Licensee) sits in Article II § IV(b) (p0073), with cost allocation at p0064. Cost is already at the preferred position (Licensor bears the cost unless a discrepancy over 5% is found), the auditor must be an independent CPA/Audit Professional chosen by mutual agreement, the scope is limited to accounting records, and there is no remote or direct system-access language. However, the clause contains no frequency cap at all, so Licensor could demand audits repeatedly — that fails both the preferred (once per 12 months) and the fallback (once per year) on a material term and edges toward the walk-away position on unlimited audits. The 30-day window to permit an audit after written request functions as adequate notice, so only the frequency (plus business-hours and auditor-confidentiality hygiene) needed fixing; the redline makes the minimal insertions and expressly excludes system access.

proposal.summary: Cap usage audits at once per 12 months, during business hours, by a confidentiality-bound auditor, with no access to Licensee systems.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a once-per-twelve-month frequency cap, business-hours limitation, a confidentiality obligation on the auditor and a no-system-access carve-out, since as drafted the audit right is unlimited in frequency. Cost allocation (Licensor bears unless a 5% discrepancy) already works for us and is unchanged.

ops.newText: (selected by mutual agreement and bound by written obligations of confidentiality) to audit

ops.oldText: Any such audit shall be permitted by Licensee within 30 days of Licensee's receipt of a written request of Licensor.
ops.newText: Any such audit shall be permitted by Licensee within 30 days of Licensee's receipt of a written request of Licensor, and shall be conducted no more than once in any twelve (12) month period, during Licensee's normal business hours, and without access to Licensee's systems or networks.
